title: Practice 6: Verbs that take the genitive

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Он заслуживает ___ (доверие).
exercises.why: «заслуживать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm not scared of terrorists.
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том попытался избежать ___ (поимка).
exercises.prompt: Tom tried to avoid being captured.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom escaped from the danger.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я хочу избежать ___ (час) пик.
exercises.prompt: I want to avoid rush hour.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I deserve a promotion.
exercises.why: «заслуживать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Они потребовали ___ (деньги).
exercises.why: «потребовать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He decided to fake his disappearance to avoid jail.
exercises.ru: Он решил сымитировать исчезновение, чтобы избежать ___.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы ожидаем ___ (прибавление) в нашей семье.
exercises.prompt: We are expecting an addition to our family.
exercises.why: «ожидать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: How can tick bites be avoided?
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Бойтесь ___ (мои способности) выражаться на "литном" наречии.
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That house cried for a coat of paint.
exercises.why: «требовать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сорок лет спустя они достигли ___ (земля) обетованной.
exercises.prompt: Forty years later, they reached the promised land.
exercises.why: «достигнуть» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She came near being run over.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том заслуживает ___ (признание).
exercises.why: «заслуживать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom had his licence suspended on the spot after crashing his car into an unmarked police car.
exercises.ru: Тома временно лишили ___, стоило ему врезаться в полицейскую машину без опознавательных знаков.
exercises.why: «лишить» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Что бы это ни было, я боюсь ___ (греки), даже когда они преподносят дары.
exercises.prompt: Whatever it is, I fear the Greeks even when they offer gifts.
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Now you've come of age, you have the right to vote.
exercises.ru: Теперь ты достиг ___, и у тебя есть право голоса.
exercises.why: «достигнуть» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Представление, что японские женщины покорны и всегда слушаются ___ (свои мужья), - это ложь.
exercises.prompt: The idea that Japanese women are submissive and always obedient to their husbands is a lie.
exercises.why: «слушаться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
exercises.ru: Каждая функция должна иметь комментарии, описывающие её назначение, чтобы избежать ___.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
